budget.cap_notes: Daniel funds the session (~$100-200 per the plan). Estimates in STAGE4-RUNBOOK.md suggest the keeper run itself is well under the cap; the cap is a hard stop, not a target. Set RunPod billing alerts before starting.
budget.pod: RunPod H100 80GB (SXM preferred), PyTorch template, 100GB network volume

data.lang_token_warning: The smoke step asserts <2yo> and <2pcm> each tokenize as a single special token. If <2pcm> does not, STOP and resolve the Naija tag before training — do not silently train Naija under a wrong tag.
data.teacher_mode_notes: both | astra | claude. DEFAULT 'both' (every record is a separate example; the two teachers are near-equal quality per Stage 1-2 findings and their disagreement is signal, not noise). This is the one config value Daniel confirms at the run's go/no-go; changing it needs no data work.

model_notes: MADLAD-400 MT models are T5-based, Apache 2.0. Input format is '<2xx> <english sentence>' where xx is the target language code. Verified against the model card 2026-11-08.

output.after_run: Download the checkpoint off the pod, sha256 it, back it up to Drive, and record the hash + final train loss + smoke/full eval numbers in STAGE4-RUNBOOK.md's run log section.
